caption:
Most auto shop owners know their car count.

Very few know these 3 numbers 👇

1️⃣ Cost per new customer
2️⃣ Estimate approval rate
3️⃣ How many customers come back within 12 months

Bays sit empty while estimates go cold. And if customers don't come back, you're fixing one car per customer, forever.

Score yourself honestly. 0, 1, 2 or 3?

Want the sheet that calculates all 3 from last month's numbers?
Comment NUMBERS and I'll DM it to you.
